title: Character
description: A named character from the A Song of Ice and Fire universe.

url.description: The canonical URL of this character resource.

name.description: The character's name. May be empty for unnamed characters.

culture.description: The culture the character belongs to.

born.description: Text description of when and where the character was born.

died.description: Text description of when and where the character died. Empty if alive or unknown.

examples: Lord Commander of the Night's Watch

father.description: URL of the character's father resource, or empty string if unknown.

mother.description: URL of the character's mother resource, or empty string if unknown.

spouse.description: URL of the character's spouse resource, or empty string if unknown.

allegiances.description: URLs of houses the character is sworn to.

books.description: URLs of books the character appears in (non-POV).

povBooks.description: URLs of books where this character has POV chapters.

tvSeries.description: TV seasons the character appears in.

playedBy.description: Actors who played this character in the TV series.
